exercises.title: Prototype types 1 — throwaway or evolutionary?
exercises.problemHtml:
A throwaway prototype answers questions, resolves uncertainties and improves requirements quality, then is discarded (a wireframe is a common example). An evolutionary prototype provides a solid architectural foundation and grows into the product; agile development is a form of evolutionary prototyping.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Throwaway: trả lời câu hỏi rồi bỏ (wireframe là ví dụ). Evolutionary: nền kiến trúc vững, lớn dần thành sản phẩm; agile là một dạng evolutionary.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Prototype types 2 — paper or electronic?
exercises.problemHtml:
Paper (low-fidelity) prototypes are cheap, fast and low-tech — paper, index cards, sticky notes, whiteboards — good for testing shared understanding early. Electronic prototypes use drawing, wireframing or prototyping tools and look real; they are better for flow and feel, and required for evolutionary prototypes.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Giấy: rẻ, nhanh, công nghệ thấp; kiểm hiểu biết chung từ sớm. Điện tử: công cụ vẽ/wireframe/prototype, trông thật; tốt cho luồng và cảm giác, bắt buộc cho evolutionary.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Prototype types 3 — from use case to UI design — answer key

1. Order the stepsSắp các bước
   Answer: a) Use case (actor actions and system responses)  →  b) Dialog map (possible UI architecture)  →  c) Throwaway prototype / wireframe (specific screens)  →  d) Detailed, usability-optimised UI design
   Use case → dialog map → wireframe → optimised UI.VI: Use case → dialog map → wireframe → UI tối ưu.

exercises.title: Prototype types 4 — evaluating a prototype
exercises.problemHtml:
Questions to ask evaluators: Does it implement the functionality as you expected? What is missing? Are there error conditions it doesn’t address? Are any functions unnecessary? Is the navigation logical and complete? Are tasks too complex (too many steps)? Watch users perform tasks rather than only asking opinions, and choose evaluators who represent the user classes.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Prototype types 4 — evaluating a prototype — answer key

1. Which is a good evaluation question?Câu hỏi đánh giá nào tốt?
   Answer: a) "What would you need to do here that this screen does not let you do?"
   Look for missing functionality.VI: Tìm chức năng còn thiếu.

2. Who should evaluate the prototype?Ai nên đánh giá prototype?
   Answer: a) Representatives of the different user classes
   Each user class has different needs.VI: Mỗi lớp người dùng có nhu cầu khác.

3. Best way to learn whether the flow works?Cách tốt nhất biết luồng có ổn không?
   Answer: a) Watch users perform real tasks with it
   Observation reveals what opinions hide.VI: Quan sát lộ ra điều ý kiến che giấu.
